2027-01-14.title: Thursday after the First Sunday after Denho · The Forty Martyrs of Sinai; St Devasahayam
readings: Justified by his grace as a gift
Do not fear those who kill the body
2027-01-14.verse: But even the hairs of your head are all counted. Do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.
theo: Paul states the heart of the Gospel: “all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God; they are now justified by his grace as a gift, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.” No one earns salvation; it is a gift received by faith. This frees us from fear of failing and from pride in succeeding. Everything we are before God is grace.

Jesus tells his friends: “do not fear those who kill the body, and after that can do nothing more.” Five sparrows sold for two pennies, yet not one is forgotten by God; “even the hairs of your head are all counted.” Today the Syriac tradition remembers the Forty Martyrs of Sinai, monks killed by raiders while praying, and the Church in India honours St Devasahayam, who gave his life for Christ in 1752. They feared God, and so they feared nothing else.
outline: Ask: what do you fear most?
All have sinned; all can be saved.
Those who kill the body can do no more.
“Do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.”
live: Thank God today for one gift you did not earn.
Do not hide your faith in one situation today.
2027-01-14.prayer: Lord Jesus, you justify us by grace and tell us not to fear. Through the prayers of the Forty Martyrs of Sinai and St Devasahayam, give us courage to witness and trust in your care, for you count every hair of our head. Amen.
altar: The martyrs offered their lives with Christ. At every Qurbono we offer ourselves with him, trusting the Father who counts every hair of our heads.

quick: All have sinned; all are offered grace as a gift.

2027-01-14.question: Which fear keeps me from living my faith openly?

family.explain: Jesus said: God does not forget even one little sparrow. He knows how many hairs are on your head! Do not be afraid.
family.intention: We pray for Christians who suffer for Jesus.
family.ask: Ask: “What are we afraid of? Let us trust Jesus together.”

illus: St Devasahayam, kept in chains for nearly three years, was led from town to town on a buffalo as a public humiliation. Witnesses said he prayed constantly and greeted visitors with peace. Before he was shot at Aralvaimozhy in 1752, he asked for a few minutes to pray. He did not fear those who kill the body.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, you tell us not to fear. Give us the courage of your martyrs as we gather. Amen.
share: All have sinned… justified by his grace as a gift (Romans 3:23–24). Do I live from grace or from my own effort?
Do not fear those who kill the body (Luke 12:4). What fear do I need to give to Jesus?
Even the hairs of your head are all counted (Luke 12:7). How does God's care touch me?
interc: For persecuted Christians, especially in Asia.
For the Church in India, through St Devasahayam.
For monks and nuns, through the Forty Martyrs of Sinai.
For our group, that we may witness without fear.
pm.close: Father, your martyrs feared you and nothing else. Make us brave witnesses, trusting in your care. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Paul writes the heart of the Gospel: all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God; they are now justified by his grace as a gift, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus (Romans 3:23–24). Salvation is a gift, not a wage.

In the Gospel Jesus says to his friends: do not fear those who kill the body, and after that can do nothing more (Luke 12:4). He reminds them: God does not forget even a sparrow. Even the hairs of your head are all counted. Do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows (Luke 12:7).

Today we remember the Forty Martyrs of Sinai, monks killed by raiders while at prayer, and St Devasahayam, the Indian layman who gave his life for Christ in 1752. They feared God, and so they feared nothing else.
Let us receive God's grace with gratitude and live our faith without fear. Amen.
kids: Children, God knows how many hairs are on your head! He takes care of you. Do not be afraid to say you love Jesus.

The martyrs show what trust in God can do.
